chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Uthman ibn Isa from Talhah ibn Zayd from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of eating clay according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the physical act of eating clay to the spiritual disease of *nifaq* (hypocrisy), reflecting the Shia scholarly view that bodily habits influence inner moral states. This connection is often interpreted through the lens of *al-muthul al-awla* (excellent similitudes), where the earthiness of clay mirrors the spiritual dryness or insincerity characteristic of hypocrites. The narration serves as a practical reminder for believers to maintain purity in both consumption and character.
